import copy
import unittest

from django.db import DEFAULT_DB_ALIAS, connection, connections
from django.test import SimpleTestCase


@unittest.skipUnless(connection.vendor == 'sqlite', 'SQLite tests')
class TestDbSignatureTests(SimpleTestCase):
    def test_custom_test_name(self):
        test_connection = copy.copy(connections[DEFAULT_DB_ALIAS])
        test_connection.settings_dict = copy.deepcopy(connections[DEFAULT_DB_ALIAS].settings_dict)
        test_connection.settings_dict['NAME'] = None
        test_connection.settings_dict['TEST']['NAME'] = 'custom.sqlite.db'
        signature = test_connection.creation_class(test_connection).test_db_signature()
        self.assertEqual(signature, (None, 'custom.sqlite.db'))

class TestDbCloneSettingsTests(SimpleTestCase):
    def test_file_database(self):
        test_connection = copy.copy(connection)
        test_connection.settings_dict = copy.deepcopy(connection.settings_dict)
        creation = test_connection.creation_class(test_connection)
        for source_name, clone_name in (
            ('test_db.sqlite3', 'test_db_1.sqlite3'),
            ('test_db', 'test_db_1'),
            ('test.db.sqlite3', 'test.db_1.sqlite3'),
        ):
            with self.subTest(source_name=source_name):
                test_connection.settings_dict['NAME'] = source_name
                clone_settings = creation.get_test_db_clone_settings('1')
                self.assertEqual(clone_settings['NAME'], clone_name)
                self.assertEqual(test_connection.settings_dict['NAME'], source_name)

    def test_in_memory_database(self):
        test_connection = copy.copy(connection)
        test_connection.settings_dict = copy.deepcopy(connection.settings_dict)
        creation = test_connection.creation_class(test_connection)
        for source_name in (':memory:', 'file:memorydb_default?mode=memory&cache=shared'):
            with self.subTest(source_name=source_name):
                test_connection.settings_dict['NAME'] = source_name
                self.assertIs(
                    creation.get_test_db_clone_settings('1'),
                    test_connection.settings_dict,
                )
